Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing beauty, elegance, and the blossoming of faith.

Fusun is also associated with Constantina, a Byzantine princess, who was loved by the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) for her exceptional beauty, inner wisdom, and strong character.
